name: Graduation House
paymentStructure: Payment Plan 01 (Monthly and Mortgage Plan): 10% initial payment towards the deposit plus £995 legal fees; the 90% balance is then payable over 36 months on a monthly basis.
warranty: Warranty cover provided at completion under CML provisions (NHBC, Zurich Municipal, Premier Guarantee, LABC or Build Zone)
headline: A student living investment by Prosperity
description: Graduation House is the first Purpose Built Student Accommodation development by Prosperity, sitting within a newly created neighbourhood of luxury apartments and stylish homes in a prime position in Beeston, Nottingham. It will consist of 162 carefully designed, fully furnished student living quarters, offering high specification and amenity, IT-proficient accommodation within the thriving Nottingham student accommodation sector.
developmentAmenities: Breakout games room with pool tables, air hockey and table tennis

specification.heading: Kitchens
items: Double base units, double and single wall units
One and a half sink unit with chrome mixer tap
Brushed metal handles to kitchen units
Fully integrated appliances to include oven, ceramic hob, extractor, and fridge freezer as per kitchen supplier's proposals

specification.heading: Bathrooms
items: Self-contained sliding door shower cubicle with tray and overhead adjustable shower head
Full-height tiling panel to the back and side of shower cubicle
Pedestal basin with high quality chrome mixer tap with tiles as a splashback
Downlights or single ceiling light positioned as per electrical layout, switch control

specification.heading: Flooring
items: Bedroom areas fitted with contemporary carpeting

locationNotes: Beeston is 3.4 miles from Nottingham city centre. By train: London St Pancras 1hr 40min, Derby 20min, Leicester 19min, Birmingham New Street 73min, Cardiff 3hrs. Trains from Beeston to Nottingham run every 15 minutes and arrive in 10 minutes; trams run every 7 minutes at peak. The M1 is around a 20-minute drive. Graduation House is a 14-minute direct tram ride to the University of Nottingham (main campus, south entrance), a 17-minute tram ride to Nottingham University Hospitals (Queen's Medical Centre), and a 30-minute bus ride to the University of Nottingham King's Meadow Campus and Nottingham Trent University (main campus).
